Excellent for an evening of northern food
Mar 2015 • Family
I can't believe how many reviews there are on this restaurant that say "average". I can only presume that these reviewers are ong tai/ba tai in town for a few days and who feel uncertain of their ground when they roam too far from the foreigner's ghetto on the south side of town. Excellent selection of northern dishes. My favorites: try the squid, or ask if they have kohlrabi (it's not always on the menu - one time I asked for it, and the waiter got on his motorcycle and drove to the market to buy some!), and the northern style nem are good too. Or try one of the dinners for two/three persons. Why come to Vietnam to eat European food?

A nostalgic asmotsphere, friendly staff, huge selection in the menu with real traditional food and unbelievably cheap pricing. It's funny how I'm from Hanoi and it isn't even possible to find such a nice restaurant in Hanoi nowadays.

You would have to visit a dozen of different places in Hanoi to be able to try what Hanoi Corner offer in their menu. Every dishes here are expertly cooked where taste, finesse and presentation come together to represent Hanoi cuisine.

My absolutely favorite restaurant in Nha Trang and I would proudly recommend Hanoi Corner to anyone because this is what North Vietnam/Hanoi food truly is.

Well worth the short walk
Aug 2014 • Friends
Firstly thanks to the reviewer below for tipping us off on the fried pork fillet, orgasmic stuff. 

This restaurant is about 12-14 minutes walk from the main strip in Nha Trang - well worth it to get away from the sea of cash rich tourists that pump up prices on the coast front. The alfresco dining is pleasant and there are a supply if fans to keep you cool. 

The owner was on hand and welcomed us with English menus and two cold beers at a record cost (in a good way of 11,000 dong - 30p so manageable, even for a Scotsman). We literally ate the place to the floor - fried Hanoi spring rolls, pork, beef and ribs alongside some chilli rice. Left feeling suitably nourished!

The restaurant has room for improvements - needs more people to create a better atmosphere. We weren't sure if it was trying to be high end or mid range. For 440k dong we were very pleased. Certainly not enough to detract from a 5 star rating.

Simple, but oh so delicious
Aug 2014 • Couples
Truly a hidden gem in Nha Trang, we were somewhat dismayed after eating at a top TA rated restaurant last night, so we decided to mix it
up a bit.. Seeking the robust and delicious flavours of Vietnam we had experienced in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh, we found this simple, unrefined, but tasty tasty restaurant. Frequented by many a local and only a small number of tourists, to be honest I was somewhat dubious, however this place delivered everything I was looking for and more! Must have the chilli salt fried rice along with the cubed beef with special sauce, this tender beef with refined complex flavours will see me coming back for more over the coming days.. Service is slightly challenging due to some language barriers, but nothing that couldn't be overcome with pointing at a menu and a few laughs.. Alcohol drinks list is limited to beer and vodka, but given it is alfresco dining, a cold beer is all your really need.. This place is a little hidden gem amongst a lot of touristy rubbish!! Take a punt and experience the real flavours of Vietnam in Nha trang here !
